summary: The design needs a stricter transport boundary, a single authenticated dispatch path, and reuse of existing task-memory artifact contracts. The largest risks are fail-open authorization, raw-result leakage through generic working memory, and treating the asynchronous JSON event bus as synchronous RPC.

suggestions.title: Make direct RPC mandatory and defer the bus carrier
suggestions.rationale: Eventbus v2 is JSON-only, at-least-once, asynchronous, and has no reply_to convention; wrapping it cannot provide synchronous cancellation, partial results, or exactly-once idempotency. Define direct RPC as the v0 transport and make bus delivery a later adapter with an explicit command/result protocol.

suggestions.title: Gate Cap’n Proto behind a transport spike with a gRPC fallback
suggestions.rationale: This repository has no Cap’n Proto precedent or dependency, while gRPC is already an optional workspace extra and navigator-eventbus has generated grpc.aio conventions. Require the spike to prove async streaming, cancellation, metadata authentication, and partial-result behavior before freezing the wire API; otherwise use gRPC with opaque bytes fields.

suggestions.title: Do not assume ToolManager categories are maintained
suggestions.rationale: ToolManager initializes, clones, and reads _categories, but register_tool and unregister_tool do not maintain that index. A RemoteToolkit built on it would produce stale mounts and unmounts unless category ownership and atomic lifecycle updates are implemented and tested; a separate remote catalog may be safer.

suggestions.title: Hash canonical capability models before provider schema conversion
suggestions.rationale: get_tool_schemas returns provider-cleaned schemas and injects _tool_instance, so hashing that output would make contract identity depend on the LLM provider and local object state. Hash a canonical Pydantic capability representation instead, and carry that digest on every call; the existing A2A client only negotiates protocol version.

suggestions.title: Resolve the shared handle contract before implementing a second one
suggestions.rationale: Task memory already provides TaskScope, EvidenceRef, ArtifactDescriptor, and a scoped ArtifactStore with immutable versions, byte bounds, publish-before-reference, and provenance. FEAT-704 also specifies owner-bound handles and audit semantics; define one neutral shared contract or an explicit adapter rather than creating parallel ResultHandle and descriptor models.

suggestions.title: Use a handle-only working-memory route for remote results
suggestions.rationale: WorkingMemoryToolkit.store_result accepts arbitrary bytes and objects, while get_result can return raw_data. Routing RemoteToolkit through that generic API can reintroduce the exact context leak the protocol is meant to prevent. Add or use a descriptor-registration path that stores only an owner-scoped handle and bounded metadata; make raw materialization an explicit, separately authorized operation.

suggestions.title: Enforce one authenticated capability dispatch path
suggestions.rationale: A2AServer has direct paths that call tool._execute, and _invoke_tool explicitly bypasses the credential gate. Separately, PBACToolCallGuardrail passes when no PermissionContext exists and PBACPermissionResolver fails open when navigator-auth is unavailable. The new server must require authenticated identity and contract authorization at the RPC boundary, then invoke through the normal gated execution path; adapters and retries must use the same dispatcher.

suggestions.title: Make required audit durability part of result acknowledgment
suggestions.rationale: AuditLedger stores the entry in memory before durable storage and deliberately swallows storage failures; its tests codify that behavior. A served capability ledger with fail-closed semantics needs a separate append contract whose durable commit, signature, and result acknowledgment ordering are explicit, with no successful result when required persistence fails.

suggestions.title: Narrow v0 artifact formats or add a real binary store
suggestions.rationale: ArtifactBlobStore currently supports canonical parquet, JSON, and text, and explicitly refuses binary and arbitrary objects. The proposed registry advertises SVG, PNG, PDF, and generic media without an implemented canonical encoding, range-read path, ACL, or TTL model. Either restrict v0 to supported evidence kinds or introduce a separately specified byte-object store before advertising those descriptors.

suggestions.title: Keep remote discovery out of AgentRegistry until its ownership is clear
suggestions.rationale: AgentRegistry manages local BotMetadata factories and BotConfig-based instantiation, whereas A2AMeshDiscovery already owns remote endpoints, credentials, health, protocol version, and skill lookup. Add a protocol-neutral remote endpoint catalog beside the mesh or make the mesh the discovery adapter; adding kind and endpoint to local bot configuration would conflate lifecycle and remote discovery.

suggestions.title: Model deterministic calls as a distinct lifecycle event
suggestions.rationale: UsageRecord is shaped around provider/model/token fields, while lifecycle already exposes TraceContext and ContextVar-based attribution. Add a capability-call event and recorder mapping containing cap_id, backing, duration, rows/bytes, policy outcome, and trace linkage instead of forcing deterministic calls into an LLM usage record with fabricated provider or token values.

suggestions.title: Add protocol conformance tests around the existing seam tests
suggestions.rationale: Current A2A tests cover JSON/version compatibility and current audit tests cover signatures, but neither exercises deterministic zero-LLM dispatch, stale-contract refusal, handle ownership, duplicate idempotency, cancellation/partials, or fail-closed authorization. Extend the test matrix to assert those properties across direct RPC and any later bus adapter, including raw-data absence from tool results and working memory.
